svg.text: Disease classification, resident death review, current vital status and audit events
Resident links refer to residents.id on page 2. A resident may have many death reports and at most one current vital-status row.
resident_vital_status.report_id references resident_death_reports.id. The current status is separate from an individual disease case marked Deceased.

These fields store account identifiers, but the inspected schema does not declare foreign keys for them: system_audit_logs.user_id; case_visits.encoded_by; health_cases.disease_reviewed_by; resident_death_reports.reported_by and reviewed_by;
users.password_hash stores a bcrypt password hash. The schema does not contain a resident sex/gender column. More than one disease case does not by itself establish clinically confirmed comorbidity.
E3 resident_death_reports.status: Pending / Confirmed / Rejected / Corrected
Local schema verified 19 October 2026. Metadata only; no patient records included.
